audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed with the packet chart and the whys text, which say the lane flips to Illaoi at 3 and stays hers to two items.
audit.why: 50.65% over 695 games. Ziggs owns levels 1-2 because you have no gap-closer; from 3 Harsh Lesson is a 4s cooldown and his only escape, Satchel Charge, is 20s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: L1-L2 Ziggs, L3 through first item Illaoi, 2+ items skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike said 'bait the satchel' without the cooldown, so the player had nothing to count.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000 range. Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s. At rank 1 your E comes back four seconds before his escape does — that gap is the entire kill window and it closes as both rank up.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed Leap of Faith drops a 'tentacle ring' that shreds him.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit' — one tentacle in a solo lane. Same error as the zac page, and the zac mirror audit already documents the correct reading. The pre-planted field does the damage, not the ult.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten. Also added the range facts the page never used: his Bouncing Bomb is 850, exactly your Tentacle Smash range, and his Hexplosive Minefield is 900 on a flat 16s that only slows, with successive detonations on the same target dealing less.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing carries resistances-invalidated for Satchel Charge, claiming it bypasses stacked resistances.
audit.why: Riot's W text says only 'The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' — no percent-health component. The percentHealth flag contradicts the description, so per the brief the description wins.
audit.corrected: Not written. Recorded as unverified rather than telling the player their armour and MR are the wrong buy.

audit.why: No defects and no suspect names in the packet; every ability name on the page matches the kit.

edits.before: This is when you flip it: once W Harsh Lesson is up you dash the gap his Q Bouncing Bomb poke relies on, land E Test of Spirit, and slam with Q. His W Satchel Charge knocks you back to reset the distance, so bait it or hold your W dash until after he satchels.
edits.after: This is when you flip it. Satchel Charge (W) is his only escape and it is down 20 seconds at rank 1 — your Test of Spirit returns in 16. Bait the satchel, then E from 900 and Harsh Lesson onto the spirit. His Bouncing Bomb reaches 850, exactly as far as your Q: answer poke with poke.

edits.before: R Leap of Faith closes onto him and the tentacle ring shreds his squishy body; he has no escape besides W satchel, which you can pre-empt. Land E first so even if he satchels away his spirit is already tethered and taking slams.
edits.after: Leap of Faith spawns one tentacle per champion hit — solo that is one, so the field you planted beforehand does the killing. Land Test of Spirit first: even if he satchels away, the spirit stays behind and keeps echoing damage to him while the tentacles swing.

edits.before: With bruiser stats and wall-fed tentacles you survive his poke and one all-in kills him; his E minefield and Q chip can't stop a committed W-E-Q-R once you're in range. Use minion waves as cover to close.
edits.after: With bruiser stats and wall-fed tentacles you survive the poke and one all-in kills him. Hexplosive Minefield (E) is a flat 16s and only slows, and repeat detonations on you deal less each time — walk through it rather than backing off.

edits.before: Ziggs bullies you at level 1-2 with long-range Q Bouncing Bomb poke and you have no gap-closer yet, so you'll take free chip walking to CS. Path around minions, dodge the Q bounce, and wait for your W before committing.
edits.after: Ziggs bullies you at 1-2: Bouncing Bomb (Q) is a 6s cooldown at rank 1 and you have no gap-closer yet. It costs 50 mana a throw though, so make him spend — path around minions, dodge the bounce, wait for Harsh Lesson.

edits.before: Once W is online at 3 the lane flips hard to you: dash the gap, E to tether, and by 6 R traps his squishy body in slams. Bait his W satchel knockback, then all-in — he has no other escape.
edits.after: Once Harsh Lesson is online at 3 the lane flips: dash the gap on its 4s cooldown, E to tether from 900, and commit at 6. Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and it is his only escape — bait it, then all-in.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Satchel Charge and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Satchel Charge and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Ziggs carry threat 7.5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Ziggs carry threat 7.5/10.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: His first two levels — L3 onward is yours. See the chart for the swing points.

notes: Third page in this slice to claim Leap of Faith drops a 'tentacle ring' (also zac and, in different words, yorick). Riot's text is one tentacle per champion hit, which in a solo lane is one — worth a repo-wide grep for 'tentacle ring' across illaoi's matchups, since the phrase reads as a promise of area damage the ult does not deliver. Did not use the _missing claim that Satchel Charge bypasses resistances: Riot's text gives it plain magic damage.
